column2: ENGLISH
Orcs and goblins grow bigger with every battle they fight and win. Now that you have come of age, your size is...
With every fight you win, you grow a little bigger and a little stronger!
WAAAGH!
A scrawny little grot has been pinchin' grub from your plate again. He's half your size and twice as slow. Every goblin knows the only way to get bigger is to make sure somebody else stays smaller...
STOMP!
Git outta 'ere before I change me mind.
Youz mates say you iz becoming weird... but maybe you iz just becoming mo' powerful! Do you want to start learnin' the deeper mysteries of Gork and Mork?
I will get da power!
Nah, I just likes to use my smasher!
[From.GetFirstName] is becoming decidedly weird... [From.GetSheHe] has started casting spells, chanting and dancing oddly!
Dat's my boy!
One of your chiefs, [From.GetTitledFirstName], has become a shaman, and is said to have been granted strange powers by Gork and Mork.
Dat 'im? He iz gonna fight and smash our enemies for us!
In times of war it's not uncommon for orc shamans to join a warboss's retinue, so that they may witness his legend in the making. One of them has turned up in your camp, claiming to be kin.
Wot? Jus' tell 'im ta stay outta mah way!
Oi'm not sure 'bout dat... Wot if he makes me 'ead splode?
Today your favourite grot dropped your best choppa on his foot when the handle came off...
Ya stupid git ruined ma best choppa!
ZOG IT!!
After doing your daily drops, you notice a goblin trying to make off with a heavy, double-bladed choppa...
Oi! Dat's mine! Git 'im, lads!
Meh, zog it...
Woit... Lessee wher' 'is stash is...
You cunningly tail the goblin back to his stash... as sneakily as an orc can...
After an almost un-orcish display of cunning, you stand before the goblin's secret stash: a pile of pilfered weapons that must have taken generations of goblins to collect.
Dat's gonna git me a big bag o' teef!
Oi know a few lads who'd loik a gud choppa...
Some goblin told me I could get a lot more fungus beer if I planted the fungus on my own personal droppin' ground...
Wot if we try ta stick YOU in da ground instead?
Gud idea, Skumzog!
The boyz look around all shifty-eyed at the fungus beer you "cultivate".
Dat's it, lads! Drink up! Wot? Don't mind da aftertaste...
Makes me wonda... wot if I use da fungus after all...
Maybe your brews will go down better if they don't contain rotting goblin...
I recently placated an upstart orc by tanking him full of booze...
Have anuvva, boyz!
I could make me a right gud fungus wine outta dis...
There's nothing more orcish than getting stinking drunk!
Da gobbos I planted aren't making fer very gud beer...
...But dey look zoggin' nice on me lawn!
Mebbe I should plant fungus instead...
Since I put Skumzog's head on a stick, no goblin has tried making off with any of my choppas.
If Oi put up more, Oi bet dey won't even drop on me lawn!
Dat's da spirit!
The boyz have been strangely motivated lately...
Dat's jus' cuz I'm da best brewer in da camp.
Me garden showed 'em wot's wot!

The grots digging new tunnels under your hold have broken into a cave full of squigs: round, red, all mouth and teeth, bouncing off the walls and off each other. Two of the diggers are already inside one of them.
Round 'em up! A herd o' squigs is worth a fortune!
Squig stew fer everyone!
Dey bite. Wall it up again.

Your squig pen is a great success. The herd has doubled, and has only eaten two herders, a wall and most of a cart. The herd-gits say that with enough fungus and enough herders the biggest ones could grow very big indeed.
Bigger squigs! Feed 'em da fungus... and da slow herders.
If the squigs take to the feeding, one of them may grow into something truly enormous...
Sell 'em to da boyz fer a pile o' teef, and keep a good 'un fer meself.
It happened. One of the squigs ate everything else in its pen, then the pen, and is now the size of a troll. The herders call it Big Gob and refuse to go near it. It is looking at you.
Oi'm ridin' it! Get me a saddle... and a long stick.
Make it da boss o' da herd. Da uvvers will fall in line.
With Big Gob bossing them about, the squigs have bred into a herd that fills every cave under your hold. Something has to be done with them before they start on the boyz.
Strap some hoppers on 'em and point 'em at da enemy!
SQUIG FEAST! Everybody eat till ya burst!
Squig Pen
This character keeps a pen of wild squigs. So far it has eaten only a few herders.
Squig Herd Boss
A great cave squig bosses this character's squig herd, and everyone knows whose squig it is.
Great Cave Squig Rider
This character rides a great cave squig into battle, mostly in the right direction.
Squig Hoppers
This character's host is full of squig hoppers bouncing at the enemy.
